description: Create an APM retention filter with query, sample rate, and enable/disable

enabled.description: Whether the filter is enabled (default true)

filterQuery.description: Span search query. Example: service:web-app AND @duration:>1s

rate.description: Sample rate (0.0 to 1.0). Example: 1.0 for 100%, 0.5 for 50%

name: create-apm-retention-filter
